signIn.title: Sign in to austeris
signIn.wrong: That email and password do not match.
signIn.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.

form.incomplete: Some of the form is not filled in.
form.positiveAmounts: Amounts are written as positive numbers; whether money goes out or comes in is the kind of entry.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: What every account holds today, as its bank would say it.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.currencyHelp: A three-letter code: PYG, USD, RUB - or a coin's, such as BTC.
accounts.openingHelp: What was in it before austeris knew about it.
accounts.emptyBody: An account is where money sits: a wallet, a bank account, a card. Open the first one to start recording.
accounts.unconverted: Not counted - no rate known for {{currencies}}.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Every movement of money, newest first.
entries.emptyBody: Type a line above - 45000 food lunch - or open a full entry.

quick.label: Record an entry in one line
quick.help: Amount, category, words - then from account, @who, #tag, a currency code and @rate. A leading ~ marks it held.

entry.title: Entry
entry.counterpartyHelp: Who was paid, or who paid. A new name is created when the entry is saved.
entry.tagsHelp: One word each; press Enter after each.
entry.badTags: A tag is one word starting with a letter: {{tags}}
entry.held: Held - the bank has not posted it yet
entry.transferCurrencies: A transfer stays in one currency. Use Exchange to change money from one into another.
entry.actualAmountHelp: Only if the bank posted a different amount than was held:
entry.deleteBody: It goes to the trash with its files, and can be brought back from there as it was.
entry.keptNote: This is a trade's money, kept by {{module}}: its day, description and amounts change with the trade, and it is deleted with it.
entry.sortLater: Leave a category empty to sort it later: the entry is recorded as unsorted.

exchange.title: Exchange money
exchange.sameCurrency: Both accounts are in the same currency. That is a transfer.
exchange.noReference: no day's rate to measure against
exchange.staleNoFee: the day's rate is too old to measure against
exchange.slipRead: From the slip: {{what}}. Check it before recording.
exchange.slipNothing: Nothing legible on the slip; type the amounts. The photo is still kept with the exchange.
exchange.slipKept: The slip's photo is kept with the exchange.
exchange.slipAttachFailed: The exchange is recorded, but its photo could not be kept: {{problem}}

record.title: Record
record.description: What was just spent, in a line or with a press.
record.noButtons: No buttons yet. Open an entry below and make it a button: one press records it again.

template.name: On the button
template.askAmount: Ask for the amount each time
template.amountHelp: Left empty, the button asks each time.

entry.possible_duplicate: The same entry was recorded {{seconds}} s ago.
entry.kept: This entry is kept by {{module}}: its day, description and money change there, and it is deleted there.
entry.not_in_trash: There is no such entry in the trash.
entry.too_few_lines: An entry has two sides at least: money leaves somewhere and arrives somewhere.
entry.line_side: A line names an account, a category or a conversion - exactly one of them.
entry.line_zero: A line of zero records nothing.
entry.unbalanced: The entry does not balance in {{currency}}: the lines sum to {{sum}}.
entry.not_yours: The entry names a counterparty or a category that is not yours.
entry.unknown_reference: The entry names an account or a category that does not exist.
entry.side_gone: The entry moved money on an account or under a category that no longer exists, so it cannot come back as it was.
entry.posted_again: The module that posted this entry has posted it again since; the newer one stands.
entry.posts_before_made: A payment posts on or after the day it was made, {{day}}.
entry.already_posted: This entry was posted on {{day}} already.
entry.repost_accounts: This entry moves {{count}} accounts, so which of them posted for another amount is not said; record it again instead.
entry.repost_split: A split entry does not say which of its parts posted for another amount; record it again instead.
entry.repost_not_payment: Only a payment to a category posts for another amount; record a transfer again instead.
entry.repost_currencies: This conversion's categories are not in one other currency; record it again instead.
entry.between_accounts: This entry moves money between accounts, so it is not one payment.
entry.no_account: This entry moves no account, so it is not one payment.
entry.split: This entry is split across categories, so it is not one payment.
entry.no_category: This entry is on no category, so it is not one payment.

line.empty: There is nothing here to record.
line.no_amount: “{{word}}” is not an amount; a line starts with one, as in 45000 food lunch.
line.zero_amount: An entry of zero records nothing.
line.bad_rate: “{{word}}” is not a rate; write it as @5965.
line.bare_at: @ names nothing: @5965 is a rate, @shop is who was paid.
line.twice: “{{word}}” says again what the line already said; one rate and one counterparty to a line.
line.income_category: “{{category}}” is money coming in; write +{{amount}} for that.
line.expense_category: “{{category}}” is money going out; leave the + off for money spent.
line.no_open_account: There is no open account to record this against; open one first.
line.which_account: Which account? Choose one, or write from {{example}} - you have {{accounts}}.
line.unknown_category: You have no category called “{{name}}”; create it first.
line.ambiguous_category: “{{name}}” is more than one category ({{names}}); say which, as in living/{{name}}.
line.rate_without_currency: A rate converts an amount in another currency; this one is already in {{currency}}.
line.no_rate: No {{from}} to {{to}} rate is known on or before {{day}}; state the one you were charged, as in @5965.

template.name_taken: There is already a button by that name.
template.order_incomplete: An order names every button of yours, each once.
template.asks_amount: “{{name}}” asks for the amount each time; say how much.

attachment.too_large: A file can be up to {{limit_mb}} MB.
attachment.unsupported: Only a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), a PDF or an XML receipt can be kept.
attachment.already_attached: This file is on the entry already.
attachment.not_in_trash: There is no such file in the trash.
attachment.entry_in_trash: The entry this file was on is in the trash; restore the entry and its files come back with it.

request.too_large: That is more than {{limit_mb}} MB - too large to send.
request.malformed: The server could not read that request: {{why}}
request.not_json: That request was not sent as JSON.
request.rate_limited: Too many requests; wait a moment and try again.
request.backwards_window: The window ends on {{to}}, before it starts on {{from}}.

module.switched_off: This part of austeris is switched off on this installation.
module.not_answering: The {{module}} module is not answering. Try again in a moment.

document.unsupported: Only a receipt's XML is read into the books; a photo or a PDF is attached to its entry instead.
document.too_large: A file can be up to {{limit_mb}} MB.
document.unreadable: This file cannot be read as XML.
document.not_a_receipt: This XML file is not a SIFEN receipt.
document.several: This file holds {{count}} documents; one receipt per file.
document.not_a_payment: This is a {{kind}}, which records no payment.
document.incomplete: The receipt has no {{what}}, or it is not one.
document.unknown_account: The folder is named “{{name}}”, and you have no account called that.
document.no_rate: The account is in {{to}}, the receipt in {{from}}, and no rate is known on or before {{day}}.
document.ledger_unavailable: The books could not be reached; book it again in a moment.

slip.ocr_unavailable: This installation cannot read photos: it has no OCR.
slip.unsupported: A slip is read from a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.

trade.unknown_account: That account is not one of yours.
trade.unknown_instrument: That instrument is not in the catalogue.
trade.not_a_holding_account: Positions are held on a broker's or a wallet's account; {{name}} is not one.
trade.closed_account: {{name}} is closed; nothing new happens on it.
trade.money_not_holding: {{symbol}} is money here: it is an account's balance, not a position.
trade.fee_too_large: The fee is as much as the trade itself.
trade.nothing_moved: This trade moves less than one unit of {{currency}}.
trade.oversold: That would leave {{short}} {{symbol}} fewer than were held at the time.
trade.receive_unpriced: Say what a unit of {{symbol}} was worth when it arrived - 0 if nothing: prices have none for that moment.
trade.refused_by_ledger: The books refused the trade's money: {{message}}
trade.nothing_traded: A trade is of more than nothing.
trade.price_required: A buy or a sale has a price, of more than nothing.
trade.one_account: Only a transfer goes to another account; a buy, a sale or a receipt happens on one.
trade.negative_worth: What a unit was worth is not below nothing.
trade.receive_fee: Units received cost nothing to receive; a fee belongs to a buy or a transfer.
trade.transfer_priced: A transfer has no price; nothing was paid.
trade.transfer_target: A transfer goes to another account; choose which.
trade.transfer_to_self: A transfer goes to another account than it left.
trade.in_future: A trade is of a moment that has happened.
trade.key_empty: An idempotency key cannot be empty.
trade.key_too_long: An idempotency key is {{limit}} characters at most.
trade.not_in_trash: That trade is not in the trash any more.
trade.key_taken: A trade recorded since under the same key, {{key}}, stands for this one.

portfolio.ledger_unavailable: The books are not answering; nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
portfolio.market_unavailable: Prices are not answering; nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
portfolio.future_day: A day that has not happened has no value yet.

server.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.

auth.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again.
auth.wrong_password: The email or the password is wrong.
auth.locked_out: Too many wrong passwords in a row. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.

currency.not_a_code: “{{currency}}” is not a currency code; three letters, as in USD, or an exchange's ticker, as in USDT.

amount.not_positive: An amount has to be more than nothing.
amount.too_precise: {{amount}} has more decimal places than {{currency}} has.

account.name_taken: You already have an account by that name.

category.parent_not_found: The parent category is not one of yours.
category.name_taken: A category by that name is already there.
category.fee_blocked: Exchange fees have no category to go in: the one by that name is money coming in.

counterparty.in_use: Entries name this counterparty; change them first.
counterparty.bad_tax_id: “{{tax_id}}” is not a tax number; letters and digits, as in 80012345-6.
counterparty.tax_id_taken: Another of your counterparties has that tax number.
counterparty.name_taken: You have a counterparty typed the same way as “{{name}}”.
counterparty.untypeable: “{{name}}” has no letter or digit in it, so it could never be typed.
counterparty.merge_itself: A counterparty is merged into another, not into itself.
counterparty.merge_tax_ids: One carries the tax number {{from}} and the other {{into}}: two businesses, not one typed two ways.

place.bad_country: “{{country}}” is not a country code; two letters, as in PY or BR (the United Kingdom is GB).

tag.bad_name: “{{tag}}” is not a tag; a tag is one word starting with a letter, as in holiday-2027.
tag.name_taken: You have a tag by that name.

exchange.not_positive: An exchange gives something and gets something; both amounts are more than nothing.
exchange.same_currency: Both sides are in {{currency}}; money that stays in one currency is a transfer.
exchange.too_small: {{amount}} is too small to be worth anything in {{currency}}.
exchange.wrong_reference: A {{base}} to {{quote}} rate cannot measure a conversion from {{given}} into {{got}}.

rate.same_currency: A currency is worth one of itself.
rate.not_positive: A rate is a positive number.
rate.not_found: No {{from}} to {{to}} rate is known on or before {{day}}.
rate.future_day: No source publishes a rate for a day that has not happened.

price.not_positive: A price has to be more than nothing.
price.in_future: A price is of a moment that has happened.
price.bad_source: “{{source}}” is not a source's name; lowercase letters, digits and dashes, as in austeris-2025.
price.live_source: {{source}} is a source this installation asks itself; record prices brought from elsewhere under another name.
price.none_given: There are no prices to record.
price.too_many: {{count}} prices in one call; {{limit}} at most.

source.switched_off: The {{source}} source is switched off on this installation.

batch.too_large: One change reaches {{limit}} entries at most; {{count}} are chosen.
batch.one_change: Say one change: a category, an account to move to, or labels.
batch.no_tags: Say which labels to put on or take off.
batch.missing: {{count}} of the chosen entries are not there any more; refresh the list.
batch.same_account: The money is on that account already.
batch.closed_account: {{name}} is closed; nothing new happens on it.
batch.other_currency: The money is in {{from}} and that account is in {{to}}; moving it would need a rate.
batch.onto_itself: {{count}} of the chosen entries already move money between these two accounts.
batch.kept: {{count}} of the chosen entries are kept by {{module}}; their money changes there.

files.title: Files
files.none: No files yet: a photo of the receipt, the bank's PDF.

history.title: History
history.outside: outside austeris, straight in the database

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted entries, files and trades wait here for {{days}} days, then they are erased for good.
trash.emptyStateBody: A deleted entry, file or trade waits here for {{days}} days before it is erased.
trash.eraseEntryBody: The entry goes with its history and its files, and nothing brings it back.
trash.eraseFileBody: Nothing brings the file back afterwards.
trash.emptyBody: Everything in it is erased for good: the entries with their history and files, the files taken off entries, and the trades with their history.
trash.eraseTradeBody: The trade is erased with its history, and cannot be brought back.

imports.title: Import
imports.description: Receipts read into the books: a SIFEN receipt's XML becomes one entry with a line per item, the shop and the file itself.
imports.paidFromHelp: For receipts that do not say - a card payment does not say which card.
imports.folder: Receipts dropped in the installation's folder arrive here too.
imports.waitingHelp: Say what each one does not, and it goes into the books.
imports.emptyBody: Choose a receipt's XML file - the one the shop e-mails - and it is in the books with its items, its shop and the file.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: What you hold at brokers and on exchanges, and what it is worth.
portfolio.emptyBody: Open a brokerage or a crypto wallet account on the Accounts screen - its balance is the money trades there are paid in - then record a trade.
portfolio.unvalued: Not in the total, for want of a price: {{symbols}}
portfolio.stale: Some prices are older than they stay current for.

trade.noAccounts: Trades happen on a brokerage or a crypto wallet account; open one on the Accounts screen.
trade.networkFee: In {{symbol}}, as the network takes it
trade.noMoney: A transfer moves no money: the units go to another account of yours.
trade.incomplete: Choose the account, the instrument and, for a transfer, where it goes.
trade.deleteBody: Its money leaves the books with it. What happened to it stays in its history.
trade.emptyBody: A buy, a sale or a transfer between your accounts. Its money is booked with it.
trade.worthHelp: When it arrived, in {{currency}}. Empty takes the market's price of that moment; 0 is nothing.
trade.worthHelpAny: When it arrived, in the account's currency. Empty takes the market's price of that moment; 0 is nothing.
trade.noMoneyReceived: Units received move no money: what they were worth is what they cost.

instrument.emptyBody: A coin, a share, a fund - or a flat, priced by hand. With a CoinMarketCap key the market fills the catalogue itself.
instrument.symbolHelp: As the world writes it: BTC, AAPL.
instrument.name: Name
instrument.priceHelp: A price you read somewhere. The newest price is the one used, whoever said it - until a source says a newer one.

snapshot.emptyBody: A snapshot keeps what the portfolio held and was worth on a day, to compare with later.
snapshot.incomplete: Some of it had no price
snapshot.takeHelp: What the portfolio holds and is worth, in {{currency}}, kept as it is. A day past is valued at that day's prices.
snapshot.unvalued: Without a price, left out of the totals: {{symbols}}
snapshot.deleteBody: It is gone for good; the trades are not touched.

gains.noSalesBody: A sale shows here with what it brought in and what the lots it took cost.
gains.unvalued: Left out of the sums, for want of a rate into {{currency}}: {{symbols}}
gains.feesIncluded: Fees are in already: a lot costs its buy's fee as well, and proceeds are net of the sale's. Their category (Trading fees) counts the same fees as spending.
gains.methodsHelp: Which lots a sale takes. Changing it counts every gain on the account again, past years too.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.description: Letters wait while you type in a field.

batch.label: What to do with the chosen entries
batch.notMovable: The chosen entries are on different accounts; narrow the list to one account to move them.
batch.categorizeBody: Unsorted money and money on your own categories goes under the one chosen. Fees an exchange or a trade took stay where they are.
batch.moveTitle_one: Move the entry to another account
batch.moveBody: Their money moves from {{account}} to an account in the same currency.
batch.tagBody: Labels are put on and taken off every chosen entry.
batch.takeOffHelp: Labels to take off, where they are.

merge.title: Merge {{name}} into another
merge.body: Entries and buttons with {{name}} name the one chosen instead, and typing @{{name}} finds it from now on. {{name}} is deleted.
